listeningQuestions.audio: You should wait until everyone has been served before you start eating.
opts: 你应该等大家都上了菜再开始吃。
你吃完后应该马上离开。

listeningQuestions.audio: This soup is too salty, so let's add a little water.
opts: 这碗汤太咸了,我们加点水吧。

listeningQuestions.audio: You needn't try the stinky tofu if you really don't want to.
opts: 如果你实在不想吃,可以不尝臭豆腐。

listeningQuestions.audio: The chef recommended the fish, and it was truly delicious.
opts: 厨师推荐了这道鱼,确实很美味。

listeningQuestions.audio: A balanced diet should include fresh fruit and vegetables.
opts: 均衡的饮食应该包含新鲜的水果和蔬菜。
我们应该多吃油炸食物。

listeningQuestions.audio: You mustn't put metal plates in the microwave; it is dangerous.
opts: 千万不要把金属盘子放进微波炉,那很危险。
你可以用金属盘子加热食物。

reading.passage: Growing up with a British father and a Chinese mother, I have always loved food from both cultures. My favourite treat is a cross-cultural afternoon tea: English biscuits with a cup of Chinese tea.
reading.passageCn: 在英国父亲和中国母亲的家庭里长大,我一直热爱两种文化的食物。我最喜欢的享受是一顿跨文化的下午茶:英式饼干配一杯中国茶。

questions.q: Why does the writer love food from two cultures?
opts: The writer's parents come from different cultures.
The writer disliked all home food.
The writer ran a tea shop.

writing.prompt: Write 3-4 sentences giving advice on healthy eating. Use one modal of advice (should / ought to) and one of obligation or prohibition (must / have to / mustn't / needn't).
writing.promptCn: 用3-4句话给出健康饮食的建议。用一个表建议的情态动词(should / ought to),再用一个表义务或禁止的情态动词(must / have to / mustn't / needn't)。

lines.text: I can't decide what to have. Any suggestions?
lines.cn: 我拿不定主意点什么,有建议吗?

lines.text: If you like spicy food, you should try the Gong Bao chicken.
lines.cn: 如果你喜欢辣的,你应该尝尝宫保鸡丁。

lines.text: Sounds great. Should we order a soup too?
lines.cn: 听起来不错。我们还要点个汤吗?

lines.text: Yes, but let's avoid the salty one and have the tomato and egg soup.
lines.cn: 好,不过别要太咸的那种,点番茄蛋汤吧。
